image_description: A close-up view of a classic car wheel mounted on a black vehicle. The wheel features a whitewall tire with visible tread and sidewall texture, mounted on a black steel rim with a polished silver lip. A chrome hubcap covers the center, featuring a central emblem and simulated bolt holes around the perimeter. The wheel is partially framed by the car's black fender arch.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The tire tread pattern becomes slightly soft and lacks micro-definition towards the bottom right. The whitewall transition is smooth but lacks the slight molding seam often seen in real tires.
The reflections on the chrome hubcap are somewhat generic and do not perfectly map to the surrounding environment (fender/tarmac), appearing slightly 'painted on' rather than optically reflected.
The edge where the black fender meets the background sky/reflection is slightly wavy and lacks a crisp hard edge, suggesting minor generation blur or boundary bleeding.

focus_areas: Integrity of the tire-to-rim seal (no bleeding/fusion)
Optical correctness of chrome reflections on the hubcap
Sharpness and realism of the tire tread pattern
Geometric circularity of the wheel under perspective
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the hubcap reflections; AI often fails to render complex curved mirror surfaces accurately. Also, inspect the tire sidewall for any 'melting' into the rim or lack of distinct material boundaries. Check if the bolt hole mimics on the hubcap are symmetrically consistent.
